leadText:
This is the seventh chapter of the Pokémon Mezastar: Aim to Be a Tag Master! manga. It was first published in the January 2022 issue of CoroCoro Ichiban!, released on November 20, 2021. It is 18 pages long.

It was made available on Weekly CoroCoro Comics on July 15, 2022.
